notes.title: Update Notes for May 27
notes.notes:
[h1]“The Real Trial Begins”[/h1]

[h2]Highlights[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Combat System Revamp[/b] - No more timers. Dodge → Trial Master Appears → Hit them hard → Repeat. Simple. Brutal. Satisfying. [i]What we want from you all is feedback to improve this system.[/i]
[*][b]Full Localization Support[/b] – Now playable in Japanese (コア・トライアルズ) and Spanish!
[*][b]Updated attacks[/b] – Refined attacks, New animations, and tuned difficulty.
[*][b]More Sound Tracks[/b] – Upbeat chiptune tracks, courtesy of [url=https://opengameart.org/users/wyver9]Wyver9[/url].
[*][b]Complete UI Overhaul[/b] – New UI, smoother setup, better vibes.
[*][b]Bug Fixes[/b] – No more data related issues in the future. Hopefully.
[/list]

[h2]Detailed Patch notes[/h2]

[b]Combat System Revamp[/b]
[list]
[*]You now [b]dodge a few attack waves[/b], then the [b]Trial Master appears[/b].  
[*]You [b]deal damage[/b] by attacking directly with your core during this window.  
[*][b]No time limit[/b]. Survive and strike until they fall.  
[/list]

[b]Full Localization Support[/b]
[list]
[*]Japanese and Spanish language support added!
[*]コア・トライアルズ welcomes its Japanese fans with full translations.
[*]¡Y también, nuestros amigos latinos ya pueden esquivar la muerte en español!
[/list]

[b]Updated attacks[/b]
[list]
[*]Every attack has been re-tuned for better feel and punch.
[*]Stronger feedback, improved visuals, and tighter hitboxes.
[/list]

[b]More Sound Tracks[/b]
[list]
[*]Added [b]custom music for each level[/b], hand-picked to enhance the mood and intensity.
[*]All current tracks created by [url=https://opengameart.org/users/wyver9]@wyver9[/url].
[*]More original music from commissioned artists will arrive in future updates.
[/list]

[b]Complete UI Overhaul[/b]
[list]
[*]New [b]Title Screen[/b] added – More user and streamer friendly. Tutorial is strictly optional.
[*][b]Camera selection system[/b] improved – easily select your device from settings.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Player data has been reset.
[*]This should [b]resolve all corruption issues[/b] going forward.
[*]Previous issues were caused by a dev (yes, it was Syncroxd, your Friendly Temmie). Oopsie Daisy Lol.
[/list]

[h2]Tell Us What You Think[/h2]
Your feedback has shaped this update. Drop your thoughts in [url=https://discord.gg/kgprfhtUay]our Discord[/url], leave a review on Steam, or throw suggestions at us. We read everything. Sometimes twice.

[h2]What's Next?[/h2]
This is our first big update! but not the last. More big stuff is coming soon. And when we say “next week,” we mean... hopefully. You've got a better shot at having a fish start flying than us meeting the deadlines.

[h1]WISHLIST NOW![/h1]
We're aiming for [b]10,000 wishlists![/b] Every single wishlist makes a difference. [b]Add it to your wishlist[/b]. It helps visibility and helps us continue development!
